dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL for Japan Medical Association. Uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with Unix-style file paths (/var/tmp/), COPY statements with .INC files, and no COMP-3 usage.
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL with FILE STATUS

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - hospital admission (nyuin) medical procedure entry/registration subsystem for Japanese national health insurance billing
purpose.summary: This program is the hospital admission (nyuin) medical procedure input component of the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system. It handles entry and registration of medical procedures for inpatient care, including insurance combination checks, prescription checks, and various medical billing validations. It is a large, production-grade batch/interactive program with extensive revision history from 2002 to 2014.

notable_features: 64 COPY statements referencing external copybooks (.INC files)
90 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram architecture
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Multiple SPA (scratchpad area) data structures for screen management
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the visible text. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient evidence exists for classification. The ORCGK02NYU program ID corresponds to the K02 (shinryo koui nyuryoku - medical procedure input) hospitalization entry screen component.
